results.title: Major pay boost locked in for Victorian teachers, strike action called off
results.description: A planned 24-hour strike on Wednesday has been scrapped, ending months of industrial action after statewide teacher walkouts.

results.title: Only 7 of 16 SADC States Ratify Free Movement Pact
results.description: SADC leaders meet in Durban under a critical-minerals theme. The bloc's own free movement protocol has not entered into force in twenty-one years. The post Only 7 of 16 SADC States Ratify Free Movement Pact appeared first on The Rio Times .

results.title: Egypt’s US$8bn IMF Programme Ends 15 December
results.description: The IMF board cleared Egypt's seventh review on 30 July, releasing about US$1.8bn. The arrangement itself expires on 15 December 2026. The post Egypt’s US$8bn IMF Programme Ends 15 December appeared first on The Rio Times .
